lines.en: : I did {i}what?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我干了{i}什么？{/i}……

lines.en: : You, uhh...
: You did something else as well...
lines.zh: : 你还干了别的事……

lines.en: : What does that mean? What else did I do to you?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？我还对你做了什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know if you just {i}missed{/i} or...something, but...
lines.zh: : 我不知道你只是{i}没对准{/i}还是……怎么的，但是……

lines.en: : You kind of...fucked my ass.
lines.zh: : 你算是……操了我的后面。

lines.en: : And by “kind of” I mean you {i}really{/i} fucked my ass. You were {i}not{/i} gentle about it.
lines.zh: : 而且我说的“算是”，意思是你{i}真的{/i}操了我的后面。你一点都{i}不{/i}温柔。

lines.en: : Sara, I’m sorry. I must have blacked out or-
lines.zh: : Sara，对不起。我一定是断片了还是——

lines.en: : It’s fine. Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 没事。别放在心上。

lines.en: : It’s not fine. That happens sometimes and I can’t really control what’s going on while-
lines.zh: : 怎么会没事。这种事有时候就会发生，我也没法控制当时到底——

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene22
: You don’t have to explain it, Sensei. I get it.
lines.zh: : 你不用解释，Sensei。我懂。

lines.en: : What do you mean you {i}get it?{/i} This isn't something you just {i}get.{/i} It's infinitely more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 你说你{i}懂{/i}是什么意思？这不是一句“{i}懂{/i}”就能带过去的事。它比那要复杂无数倍。

lines.en: : No, I {i}get it{/i} because the same thing used to happen to me.
lines.zh: : 不，{i}我懂{/i}，是因为我也曾经发生过同样的事。

lines.en: : What?...
scene awesomesexscene23
: That’s actually what I was trying to tell you before you snapped.
lines.zh: : 其实，在你发疯之前，我想告诉你的就是这个。

lines.en: : That whole thing with the movies...and with Sana “seeing” stuff...
lines.zh: : 那一大堆关于电影的事……还有 Sana“看见”东西的事……

lines.en: : It all comes back to the same thing.
lines.zh: : 全都归结到同一件事上。

lines.en: : I don’t know exactly when it started or stopped, I just know that there were pieces of my life that never felt like they fit.
lines.zh: : 我不知道它究竟是从什么时候开始、又什么时候停下的，我只知道我人生里有那么些碎片，从来都觉得自己不属于那里。

lines.en: : Sometimes, it was a shadow in the corner of the room. Or some weird figure who would come and talk to me in some language I didn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 有时候，是房间角落里的一道影子。或者某个奇怪的人影，会过来用我听不懂的语言跟我说话。

lines.en: : Sometimes, it would be like parts of the day disappeared entirely. And I’d wake up somewhere unfamiliar without any idea of how I got there or what I was doing.
lines.zh: : 有时候，就像一整天里有些部分彻底消失了。我会在陌生的地方醒来，完全不知道自己是怎么到那儿、又在干什么。

lines.en: : I’ve been drawn to you since the moment we met and...I thought at first it was just because I have a thing for teachers.
lines.zh: : 从我们相遇的那一刻起我就被你吸引，而且……一开始我以为只是因为我对老师有偏好。

lines.en: : But I realize now that it might be for another reason entirely.
lines.zh: : 但现在我意识到，也许完全是因为另一个理由。

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene24
: That’s why I let it happen.
lines.zh: : 所以我才让它发生了。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m not mad about you interrupting our talk...or choking me...or fucking my ass with zero lube — which is a thing I absolutely {i}do{/i} own and would have gladly gotten for you...
lines.zh: : 所以我才不气你打断我们的谈话……不气你掐我……也不气你一点润滑都没有就操我后面——那东西我绝对{i}是{/i}有的，而且会很乐意去给你拿……

lines.en: : I’m not mad about any of it because I know what it’s like to lose control. And I’m not going to hold something against you that I know can’t be held in the first place.
lines.zh: : 这一切我都不生气，因为我知道失去控制是什么感觉。我不会拿一件我从一开始就知道根本抓不住的事去怪你。

lines.en: : Do you think I’m crazy?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我疯了吗？

lines.en: : Do shadows ever talk to {i}you,{/i} Sensei?
lines.zh: : 影子会跟{i}你{/i}说话吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re crazy, Sara...
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你疯了，Sara……

lines.en: : But I also don’t think there’s an easy way to explain any of that.
lines.zh: : 但我也不觉得这些事有什么简单的解释。

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene23
: I’m not looking for an explanation. I wasn’t even looking for someone to relate to tonight.
lines.zh: : 我不是在找解释。我今晚甚至连一个能共鸣的人都没在找。

lines.en: : I just wound up getting lucky for the third time in my life by finding out that the man I’ve fallen for {i}this{/i} time won’t flip his lid when he realizes what I am.
lines.zh: : 我只是这辈子第三次走了运，发现{i}这一次{/i}我爱上的男人，在看清我是什么东西之后不会当场翻脸。

lines.en: : What are you?...
lines.zh: : 我是什么？……

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene24
: Broken.
lines.zh: : 坏的。

lines.en: : We both are.
lines.zh: : 我们两个都是。

lines.en: : There might be a reason for it. There might {i}not{/i} be a reason for it. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 也许这背后有个原因。也许根本就{i}没有{/i}原因。我不知道。

lines.en: : But no one else will ever understand these missing pieces.
lines.zh: : 但别人永远不会理解这些丢失的碎片。

lines.en: : No one else will ever see that switch flip in a person and just {i}get{/i} it, because that’s something only people who have experienced it firsthand will understand.
lines.zh: : 别人永远不会看见一个人身上那个开关被拨动，然后瞬间{i}就懂{/i}——因为那只有亲身经历过的人才懂。

lines.en: : Everyone other than us will just think we’re crazy. Delusional. But it’s so...{i}so{/i} much deeper than that.
lines.zh: : 除我们以外的所有人，只会觉得我们疯了。妄想。但它比那要……{i}要{/i}深得多。

lines.en: : Which is why we need to protect Sana.
lines.zh: : 所以我们需要保护 Sana。

lines.en: : We can’t let her follow us into the dark.
lines.zh: : 我们不能让她跟着我们走进那片黑暗。

lines.en: : But how are we supposed to protect her if we can’t even figure out what’s happening with {i}us?{/i}
lines.zh: : 可如果{i}我们{/i}连自己身上发生了什么都搞不清楚，要怎么保护她？

lines.en: : The pieces may have stopped disappearing for you, but I’m losing more and more every day.  And I’ve wound up hurting people because of it.
lines.zh: : 对你来说，那些碎片也许已经不再消失了，可我每一天都在失去更多。而且我已经因此伤到了别人。

lines.en: : What if Yuki never showed up tonight? What if she hadn’t stopped me?
lines.zh: : 要是今晚 Yuki 没来呢？要是她没拦住我呢？

lines.en: : You think {i}I{/i} have the answer to that? I gave you a whole monologue about Memento because I couldn’t figure out how to properly talk about myself.
lines.zh: : 你以为{i}我{/i}会有答案吗？我给你讲了那一长串《记忆碎片》的独白，就是因为我不知道该怎么好好地谈我自己。

lines.en: : Then what are we supposed to do? And how are you so sure Sana’s right behind us?
lines.zh: : 那我们该怎么办？你又怎么能这么确定 Sana 就跟在我们后面？

lines.en: : Because it’s already started and it will only get worse.
lines.zh: : 因为它已经开始了，而且只会越来越糟。

lines.en: : I don’t know if there’s anything we can do to stop it. But if we never let her out of our sight, we can fill in all of the gaps for her.
lines.zh: : 我不知道有没有什么办法能阻止它。但只要我们不让她离开我们的视线，我们就能替她把所有的空隙都填满。

lines.en: : That’s just not reasonable, Sara. We can’t lock her up like that.
lines.zh: : 那不现实，Sara。我们不能那样把她关起来。

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene25
: I know that...of course I know that...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我当然知道……

lines.en: : I just don’t know what else to do...
lines.zh: : 我只是不知道还能怎么办……

lines.en: : When I think of how scared I was back then...and how desperately I ran from all of the shadows that were following me...and I picture {i}Sana{/i} in my place?...
lines.zh: : 一想到那时候的我有多害怕……我又是如何拼命地逃离所有跟着我的影子……再想象 {i}Sana{/i} 站在我的位置上？……

lines.en: : How can I live with that?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么带着那份心情活下去？

lines.en: : How can I live knowing how terrified and worried my daughter is as the world around her breaks into pieces?
lines.zh: : 我要怎么活下去，明知我女儿在周围的世界碎成一片片时有多恐惧、多不安？

lines.en: : You think {i}I{/i} have the answer to that? I was just choked out for sodomizing her mom.
lines.zh: : 你以为{i}我{/i}会有答案吗？我刚刚才因为鸡奸她妈妈被人掐晕。

lines.en: scene awesomesexscene26
: Heheh...that’ll be a story for the grandkids if you ever decide to marry me.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……要是你哪天决定娶我，这可就是讲给孙辈听的故事了。

lines.en: : I think you should reevaluate what stories you want to tell your fictional grandchildren.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该重新评估一下，你想讲给你那些虚构的孙辈听的都是些什么故事。

lines.en: : I’m scared, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我害怕，Sensei……

lines.en: : I thought this was over...
lines.zh: : 我以为这事已经过去了……

lines.en: : All this time, I thought I was the only one who’d ever have to go through this. It never even occurred to me that Sana could face the same thing.
lines.zh: : 一直以来，我都以为我是唯一一个必须经历这些的人。我从来没想过 Sana 也可能面对同样的事。

lines.en: : Same here. Never in a million years did I think that the part of me I’m most confused about would be one shared by {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我也是。我做梦都没想到，我身上最让我困惑的那一块，竟然是和{i}你{/i}共有的。

lines.en: : Like I said...I got lucky.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的……我走了运。

lines.en: : But what should we do now? Where should we go from here?
lines.zh: : 可现在我们该怎么办？接下来该往哪儿走？

lines.en: : I don’t have a clue. But this is your daughter we’re talking about, so you’re going to wind up being the one who has to make a decision.
lines.zh: : 我毫无头绪。但我们要谈的是你女儿，所以最后做决定的人会是你。

lines.en: : I’ll follow you when you do, though. I promise.
lines.zh: : 不过你做了决定，我会跟着你。我保证。

lines.en: : Okay...but if you bail on me like the last guy, I’m going to hunt you down. I hope you know that.
lines.zh: : 好……但要是你像上一个男人那样抛下我，我会追杀你到天涯海角。我希望你清楚这一点。

lines.en: : Feel free. It’s not like I have anywhere to go.
lines.zh: : 随便你。反正我也无处可去。

lines.en: : Sensei...can you...
lines.zh: : Sensei……你能不能……

lines.en: : Can you...stay here tonight? I don’t really want to be alone and Sana’s with Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你能不能……今晚留在这儿？我不想一个人，而 Sana 在 Ayane 那儿。

lines.en: : Sure, Sara.
lines.zh: : 好，Sara。

lines.en: : And if you decide to fuck my ass again in the middle of the night, can you use lube? I’m in a lot of pain right now.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是你半夜又想操我后面，能不能用点润滑？我现在真的很疼。

lines.en: scene black
: Sure, Sara...
lines.zh: : 好，Sara……

lines.en: : Thank you. I’ll leave it on the nightstand.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我把它放在床头柜上。

lines.en: A lie, alive, alone. This is someone else’s home.
lines.zh: 一句谎言，活着，孤零零。这是别人的家。

lines.en: I stitched these words together so they’d form another happy poem.
lines.zh: 我把这些词句缝在一起，好让它们组成另一首快乐的诗。

lines.en: I wish you were there with me — in the darkness where we slept.
lines.zh: 我希望你当时和我在一起——在我们入睡的那片黑暗里。

lines.en: “But instead you had to leave us,” quoth the creaking of the seventh step.
lines.zh: “可你偏偏不得不离开我们，”第七级台阶的吱呀声如是说。
